g.text: Twelve actual full-state histories. Error removal uses each case’s actual target; raw headings and physical geometry remain in the supporting table.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Time is linear to 0.1 then logarithmic. Rate axes are linear within ±0.001 then logarithmic in magnitude; this is not a calibrated cross-model clock.
